structure: Insurance claim adjudication: five routing designs (stipulated description)

encodings.account: design 1: the engine forwards, the adjuster decides

C.quote: The engine forwards every claim to the adjuster; the adjuster's decision goes back to the claimant.

E.quote: The engine forwards every claim to the adjuster; the adjuster's decision goes back to the claimant.

A.quote: The engine forwards every claim to the adjuster; the adjuster's decision goes back to the claimant.

E.why: Whether the engine reads the adjuster depends on whether it retrains on overrides (¶4, ¶5).

predicted.reason: A closed three-party ring binds all three.
